subsystems.name: editor-runtime
subsystems.note: Codemap cannot infer the runtime contract between the DOM-free transaction core, DOM view, and agent gateway because the coupling is carried by shared types and event origins rather than imports alone.

subsystems.name: component-compiler-gate
subsystems.note: The SFC fixtures and the published compiler version are coupled by a release boundary that Codemap cannot follow through npm package resolution.

subsystems.name: browser-acceptance
subsystems.note: Browser behavior is exercised through a served harness and Playwright project, so the runtime-to-harness relationship is a process boundary rather than a module edge.
